title: Quintessential Venezuelan Chicken Stew
description: A garlicky, fluffy Venezuelan chicken stew with a sweet-tangy twist from Branston Pickle and fermented jang, perfect for a show‑off dinner.
instructions: Heat a Dutch oven over medium heat and add olive oil, then brown the chicken thighs for 5 minutes per side until golden.
Remove the chicken and set aside.
Sauté the chopped onion in the same pot until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, cooking for 30 seconds to bloom spices.
Return the chicken to the pot, pour in chicken broth, lime juice, Branston Pickle, and fermented jang.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes to tenderize the chicken.
Remove the lid, stir, and reduce the liquid by 50% to thicken the stew, about 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.
